title: Looks good I guess?
text: The most recent major update does look slick but it's much less usable, a trend I'm not excited about at all.   My favorite thing about the app was that you open the home screen and you have your pinned trips and the subway map easily accessible.   Now you can only favorite a specific line at a station, and it will always default to showing only uptown trains for that line (regardless of whether that train actually has uptown trips from that station). Every time I need to see this info I have to open the app, swipe up to expand the trip info, and switch direction.   Station selection is also a huge pain now, meaning that you effectively *have* to have location access on unless you want to spend 5 minutes every time you want to check a station you don't frequently visit.   The maps have been completely hidden for some incomprehensible reason, now instead of a maps button on the GPS map you have to go to More -> subway maps.   None of this makes the app unusable but it makes it far less convenient, and when you're trying to frantically look up routes in the middle of a subway station convenience is at a premium. text: now it only shows you upcoming train times in your exact location, and you have to dig to view a specific station in that same transit line. that sounds nice on paper, but it’s really impractical and doesn’t allow for critical advance planning. many times i’m walking to a station further away, and i wanna know what time i’ll need to get there. other times i’m on a train with multiple viable transfers and i need to see which future transfer is coming the quickest, so that i know where to hop off. i ride on the E to 145, which means i can either get off at 7ave and take the D or i can get off at 42nd and take the A, that’s not information that you’ll receive if it’s only showing you nearby train stops.   favorites don’t save this either. for one, you run into the same issue, it’ll only show you the station nearest you, even within your favorites. but there’s another relating issue. i have multiple “favorite” locations, so i previously used the favorites tab often, but it’s a total mess. because it’s always trying to push you to train times near your location, the amount of text space that information takes up is a total waste of visual space for me and a one page list has turned into a constant scroll to find the train line i wanted to see.   the main issues (to me) with the old system was that it was buggy, and that you had a few too many tap throughs on the buses page to switch directions. now they’ve just added wayyy too many things to tap through to get to a basic piece of information.   this was my go-to app because it was the most reliable for exact times, but i’d rather an app be slightly off with an arrival time than be a waste of my time. it used to be simple and fast enough (when it wasn’t buggy) for me to check on future transfers while i was underground in-between stops, but i’d never be able to pull that with the redesign. i tried it for a few days and gave it a proper shot but i deleted it.   oh, and i almost forgot! they got rid of the widget! why???? that was so useful for getting quick information, and i could tap through to get more info on that specific train line. thankfully i found a better app that has it for free, but still. that alone made me want to delete the app.   new yorkers are fast and we need a fast app. keep it plain, simple and efficient
